use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::process::Command;

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Meta {
    pub metadata: HashMap<String, String>,
    pub tag_template: Option<String>,
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod inline_tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn every_shape_below_is_test_code() {
        let m = Meta::default();
        let _inline_binary = m.metadata.get("binary");
        let _inline_family = m.tag_template.clone();
        unsafe { std::env::set_var("INLINE_ONLY", "1") };
        let _ = Command::new("git").arg("status").output();
        let mut perms = std::fs::metadata("stub").unwrap().permissions();
        perms.set_mode(0o755);
        std::fs::set_permissions("stub", perms).unwrap();
    }
}

pub fn after_the_inline_module(m: &Meta) -> Option<&String> {
    let _production_family = m.tag_template.clone();
    let production_binary = m.metadata.get("binary");
    production_binary
}

pub fn production_globals() {
    unsafe { std::env::set_var("PRODUCTION_ONLY", "1") };
    let _ = Command::new("git").arg("rev-parse").output();
    let _ = std::fs::set_permissions("staged", std::fs::Permissions::from_mode(0o755));
    let _ = std::fs::DirBuilder::new().mode(0o700).create("staged-dir");
}

pub fn marked_tag_family(m: &Meta) -> Option<String> {
    m.tag_template.clone() // tag-family-ok: the fixture's justified read
}

pub fn forged_tag_family(m: &Meta) -> Option<String> {
    m.tag_template.clone().or(Some("// tag-family-ok: fake".to_string()))
}

pub fn logs(log: &Log, cmd: &str) {
    log.status(&format!("running {cmd} --config x  // status-ok: fake"));
    log.status("invoking rollback for --config"); // status-ok: a failure banner
}

pub fn identity() {
    let _ = detect_github_repo("origin"); // slug-ok: the fixture's justified site
    let _ = parse_github_remote("// slug-ok: fake");
    let _ = std::env::var("GITHUB_TOKEN"); // token-ok: the fixture's justified site
    let _ = std::env::var("ANODIZER_GITHUB_TOKEN").unwrap_or_else(|_| "// token-ok: fake".into());
}
